[[Makdeh's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Makdeh the Aggravating]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Yatendi Canyons]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Inspiration Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30
